subject: ROOT CAUSE stack smash: nord2_metal_bridge.c n2mb_clear 'uint8_t pixel[8]' vs clear_pixel(...,uint8_t pixel[16])
body: clear_pixel now memset()s 16 bytes (raw RT formats up to 16B) but n2mb_clear (nord2_metal_bridge.c ~l.2004) still declares 'uint8_t pixel[8]' and copies 8 bytes into the 64-byte slot: stack buffer overflow on EVERY clear-only pass (all formats). Fix: 'uint8_t pixel[16]' and memcpy(...,pixel,16) (slot is 64 bytes). Any ASan/-fstack-protector host harness hits it; release builds silently smash the stack.
